pages.image_type: annotated composite of a photograph with magnified inset boxes
pages.description: The lower portion shows a black-and-white photograph of a barren, cratered gray landscape with scattered rocks and a diagonal shadow extending across the surface, resembling a lunar or planetary surface, with a bright horizon line and dark sky above. Small cross-shaped reticle marks (fiducials) are visible across the terrain. The upper portion of the image, against the dark sky, contains five yellow-outlined square inset boxes labeled 'Area 1' through 'Area 5' with thin yellow leader lines connecting each box to a small point in the sky. Each inset displays a magnified, grainy view of a faint bluish or whitish point of light or blob against a dark background; Area 5's inset is the largest and shows a vertical elongated white and bluish smudge.

observations.claim: There are five yellow-bordered inset boxes labeled Area 1 through Area 5
The lower image is a grayscale view of a rocky, cratered surface with a horizon
A dark diagonal shadow crosses the lower foreground of the landscape
Cross-shaped fiducial reticle marks appear on the landscape
Each inset shows a faint bluish or whitish point of light against a dark sky
The Area 5 inset is the largest box and shows an elongated white-blue smudge
Yellow leader lines connect each inset box to a location in the sky
